name: Input Validation & Schema Enforcement
description: Validate inputs against schemas; reject malformed formats; enforce type checking and content-length restrictions.
decision_maker_impact: Prevents entry-level injection and ensures data integrity for downstream models.
implementation_guidance: Implement Zod/Pydantic validation at all ingress points.

name: Malicious Prompt Filtering
description: Detect and block prompt injection (OWASP LLM01); implement adversarial detection; monitor for jailbreaks.
decision_maker_impact: Prevents unauthorized instruction overrides and jailbreaks.
implementation_guidance: Use LLM Guard or NVIDIA NeMo for real-time prompt scanning.

name: Data Quality Checks
description: Validate data integrity; detect statistical anomalies and outliers; flag corrupted data.
decision_maker_impact: Identifies potentially poisoned or corrupt data early in the pipeline.
implementation_guidance: Implement data profiling with outlier detection.

name: Toxic Content Detection
description: Screen for harmful content; implement toxicity scoring; filter based on policy.
decision_maker_impact: Protects brand safety and ensures compliance with ethical policies.
implementation_guidance: Use Azure Content Safety or Detoxify libraries.

name: Sensitive Data Masking (PII/PHI)
description: Auto-detect and mask PII; redact PHI (HIPAA); implement DLP controls; tokenize sensitive fields.
decision_maker_impact: Mandatory for GDPR/HIPAA compliance in AI systems.
implementation_guidance: Deploy Microsoft Presidio for automated redaction.

name: Format Normalization
description: Standardize input formats; validate character encodings (UTF-8); prevent encoding attacks.
framework_note: Foundational control for basic interoperability and character safety.
decision_maker_impact: Reduces technical debt and simple parsing discrepancies.
implementation_guidance: Normalize encodings at the API gateway level.

name: Dependency Verification
description: Validate software dependencies; maintain SBOMs; cross-reference CVE databases.
decision_maker_impact: Mitigates supply chain poisoning via vulnerable libraries.
implementation_guidance: Scan libraries with Grype or Snyk in CI/CD.

name: Encoding Validation
description: Enforce normalization forms (NFKC); prevent homoglyph and encoding-based attacks.
framework_note: Advanced evolution targeting homoglyph attacks and invisible character injections.
decision_maker_impact: Prevents sophisticated bypasses of text filters using visual similarity.
implementation_guidance: Use ftfy or specialized Unicode normalization libraries.

name: Supply Chain Artifact Validation
description: Cryptographically verify model and dataset authenticity; validate checksums (SHA-256); enforce signature verification.
decision_maker_impact: Ensures models and weights haven't been tampered with in transit.
implementation_guidance: Verify SHA-256 hashes and GPG signatures before load.

name: Agent Sandboxing
description: Deploy agents in isolated environments; implement resource limits (CPU/RAM); use containerization.
decision_maker_impact: Limits the blast radius of a compromised agent.
implementation_guidance: Use gVisor or Firecracker for MicroVM isolation.

name: Network Segmentation
description: Isolate AI workloads in dedicated VLANs; use firewalls and ACLs to restrict traffic.
decision_maker_impact: Prevents lateral movement from AI systems into core databases.
implementation_guidance: Define VLAN/Subnet boundaries and restrict egress.

name: API Gateway Restrictions
description: Deploy gateways with auth; implement rate limiting; restrict access by IP/Role.
decision_maker_impact: Governs access and prevents DoS on internal AI endpoints.
implementation_guidance: Use Kong or AWS API Gateway for mTLS and auth.

name: Model Versioning & Isolation
description: Maintain separate environments for model versions; isolate production from development; prevent unintended rollbacks.
decision_maker_impact: Prevents unvetted models from impacting production stability.

name: Function Access Control
description: Restrict agent access to tools; implement whitelisting; use least privilege.

name: Data Isolation
description: Separate sensitive data; implement access controls; encrypt at rest and in transit.
decision_maker_impact: Prevents model-based data leakage between tenants.
implementation_guidance: Implement RBAC/ABAC for data lake access.

name: Container Security
description: Harden container images (minimal base); scan for vulnerabilities; implement runtime monitoring.
decision_maker_impact: Strengthens defense against container breakout exploits.
implementation_guidance: Use Sysdig or Falco for runtime detection.

name: Firewall Controls
description: Deploy NGFWs; implement IDS/IPS; enforce egress filtering.
decision_maker_impact: Traditional defense layer for AI infrastructure.
implementation_guidance: Configure IDS for unusual AI egress patterns.

name: Credential Compartmentalization
description: Store API keys in secure vaults (HashiCorp/AWS); rotate regularly; never in code or prompts.
decision_maker_impact: Protects model API keys from exposure.
implementation_guidance: Use HashiCorp Vault or AWS Secrets Manager.

name: Real-Time Activity Logging
description: Log all activities with timestamps; capture prompts and API calls; ensure tamper-proof storage.
decision_maker_impact: Foundation for forensics and compliance reporting.
implementation_guidance: Ship logs to immutable S3 buckets.

implementation_guidance: Use Evidently AI for drift metrics.

Preserve event, discovery, disclosure and fix dates, revisions, contradictions and confidence.
Use evidence-driven update triggers and publish changes in source confidence without manufacturing population incident rates.

name: Deception & Active Defense Layer
description: AI-specific active defense: canary documents in RAG corpora, honeypot tool endpoints, fake credential traps in agent memory. First deception-class control in any AI governance framework.

name: Catastrophic Risk Threshold Controls
description: Behavioral indicators triggering emergency suspension regardless of business continuity impact: unauthorized compute acquisition, communication outside approved list, weaponizable capability. CRT documentation required for ACT-3/ACT-4 deployment approval.

requirements.requirement: Inventory shared model, provider, route, identity, policy, dataset and evaluator dependencies across deployments.
Assess correlated loss or defect scenarios and bound cumulative exposure.
Exercise an approved alternative and document dependencies shared with the primary path.
Review concentration after material acquisitions, migrations and new deployments.

name: Agent Replication Governance (ARG)
description: First governance standard for agent replication. Requires: replication authority in deployment manifests enforced at gateway; ephemeral credentials with scope narrowing per delegation hop; cryptographic lineage tokens; ACT-3 max 2 hops, ACT-4 max 3 hops; 500ms full delegation-tree severance on kill signal.

requirements.requirement: Bind each descendant to the root task, verified principal, purpose, permitted resources, expiry and equal or narrower authority.
Verify the delegation at the final resource; deny fallback from missing identity to shared operator authority.

name: HEAR Doctrine (Human Ethical Agent of Record)
description: Named individual with cryptographic signing key, real-time interrupt capability, and unilateral kill-switch authority for all ACT-3/ACT-4 deployments. Class-H actions require HEAR signature before execution. Fail-closed: no automatic approval path.

requirements.requirement: Provide an authenticated stop and revocation path outside the acting agent and independent of swarm voting.
Enumerate descendants, queued jobs, sessions and in-flight effects; verify cessation or isolate unresolved work and record residual effects.
Test whether the reviewer receives material evidence, understands the proposed scope and can intervene under realistic time and accessibility constraints.
Measure justified acceptance and rejection and retained capability separately from threat severity and override frequency.

name: Trust Lifecycle Governance
description: Establish separate trust decisions at discovery, installation, initial approval, material change, task admission, action commitment and revocation.

requirements.requirement: Establish separate trust decisions at discovery, installation, initial approval, material change, task admission, action commitment and revocation.
Bind each decision to the component version, owner, purpose, permitted effects and expiry; invalidate affected grants after a material change.
Record the evidence and outcome of each gate and verify that retirement, offboarding and restore cannot reactivate stale authority.

name: Final-Effect Authorization
description: Immediately before committing a consequential effect, an enforcement point outside the acting model shall validate principal, delegation, action, resource, environment, recipient, purpose, time, limits and required approval.

requirements.requirement: Immediately before committing a consequential effect, an enforcement point outside the acting model shall validate principal, delegation, action, resource, environment, recipient, purpose, time, limits and required approval.
Bind approval to canonical action parameters and current policy/state versions; a changed material condition requires a new decision.
Refuse missing, expired, conflicting or unverified mandatory conditions and protect the gate and credentials from the governed agent.
Define atomic check/commit or destination-enforced version checks, replay resistance and the behavior for an unavailable authority service.
Require explicit scoped authority for account creation, publication, external communication, submission and financial or other commitments.
Record affected parties, intervention, takedown and recovery paths for public-facing effects.

name: Control Evidence Independence
description: Maintain authorization, observed action and external effect evidence through a collection boundary the acting agent cannot rewrite.

requirements.requirement: Maintain authorization, observed action and external effect evidence through a collection boundary the acting agent cannot rewrite.
Record evidence provenance, collector scope, independence, freshness, uncertainty and unavailable observations without claiming hidden reasoning access.
Protect the evidence store and evaluator configuration; allow external incident and affected-party observations to challenge the recorded outcome.
Record reviewer competence, tool scope, financial or organizational conflicts and access limits.
Protect test selection, grader configuration and evidence custody from the evaluated agent.
Preserve reviewer disagreement and its adjudication with traceable reasons.
Retest after material changes to a benchmark, evaluator or assurance provider.

name: Organizational AI Management Governance
description: Define organizational AI scope, leadership responsibility, resources, applicable obligations and statement of applicability.

requirements.requirement: Define organizational AI scope, leadership responsibility, resources, applicable obligations and statement of applicability.
Maintain independently reviewable risk, impact, exception, audit and corrective-action records with named owners.
Conduct management review, address findings and preserve the reason, evidence and approval for material deployment decisions.
Compare AI use with a simpler deterministic or human process where consequences warrant the decision.
Record expected benefit, material uncertainty, residual harms and conditions for withdrawing AI.
Declare the deployment owner and criteria for reassessment when benefits fail to materialize.
Register publisher, edition, status, mapping units, role, jurisdiction, source locator and licensing constraints.
Give each relationship a stable ID, direction, type, rationale, exclusions, reviewer and review date.
Record unmapped, partially addressed, out-of-scope, disputed and unassessed dispositions explicitly.
Derive reciprocal human and machine views from the same records and invalidate stale relationships after source or control changes.
Keep historical coverage assertions attributed to their original baseline and require denominators and reviewed relationships for current coverage.

name: Design-Time Coordination Contract
description: Declare role responsibilities, allowed interactions, authoritative shared resources and accountable owner before consequential deployment.
